title: Lifting coordinates from a smooth closed subscheme
statement: Let S,X,Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p:X→S and q:Y→S with q smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and i:Y→X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with i p=q. Fix y∈Y and an affine open U₀∋i(y), an isomorphism U₀≅Spec A, and a finite A-regular sequence f [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] identifying Y×_X U₀ with Spec(A/(f)) over U₀. There exist a≥0 and an open U⊆U₀ containing i(y), together with S-morphisms h:U→A^(a+length f)_S and v:Y×_X U→A^a_S [def-sbc-affine-space, def-pc-base-change], such that v is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], the square with the inclusion setting the last length f coordinates to zero is cartesian, and on every affine open W⊆U the kernel ideal of Y×_X U→U [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is spanned by the last coordinate pullbacks, which are weakly regular. No smoothness of p and no etaleness of h is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Apply [sbc-thm-etale-local-normal-form] to the smooth closed subscheme at y. Restrict the base to its affine chart and choose an ambient principal affine neighbourhood inside U₀ whose closed preimage lies in the etale chart, using the subspace topology of a closed immersion. Localizing preserves the given regular sequence, since localization is flat and the retained point keeps the final quotient nonzero. Restricting the chart and composing with the affine-space map induced by the base open preserves etaleness [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation].

proof.text: The new ambient and closed subscheme are affine and the closed morphism gives a surjection on global sections. Lift the first a coordinate functions, append the localized prescribed f, and use [def-sbc-affine-space] to form h. The quotient by the last coordinate pullbacks is exactly the closed subscheme: the tensor product with the polynomial quotient by those variables equals A/(f), by u tensor p-bar mapping to u p(g,f) mod (f), with inverse u-bar mapping to u tensor 1. Thus the square is cartesian.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, displayed coordinate map and finite-presentation permanence; explicit finite presentation and fibre-product computation

proof.text: The equations generate the kernel ideal after restricting to any affine open, by localization of the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf. Such sections are flat over the ambient affine coordinate ring; tensoring each successive multiplication injection preserves weak regularity. The final quotient is allowed to be zero on an affine open missing the closed subscheme. Composition with the affine-space open immersion over the base open keeps the square cartesian and v etale.

theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_coordinate_lift_of_regular_equations
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) (q : Y ⟶ S) (i : Y ⟶ X)
    [Smooth q] [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ p = q) (y : Y)
    (U₀ : X.Opens) (hy₀ : i y ∈ U₀) (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (eA : U₀.toScheme ≅ Spec A) (f : List A)
    (hf : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A f)
    (eY : pullback i U₀.ι ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)))
    (heY : eY.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList f))) =
      pullback.snd i U₀.ι ≫ eA.hom) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (_ : U ≤ U₀) (_ : i y ∈ U)
      (h : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (a + f.length))) S)
      (v : pullback i U.ι ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) S),
      h ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (a + f.length))) S ↘ S) = U.ι ≫ p ∧
      IsPullback v (pullback.snd i U.ι)
        (AffineSpace.homOfVector (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) S ↘ S)
          (fun j ↦ Fin.addCases (fun k ↦ AffineSpace.coord S (ULift.up k))
            (fun _ ↦ 0) j.down)) h ∧
      Etale v ∧
      ∀ W : U.toScheme.affineOpens,
        (pullback.snd i U.ι).ker.ideal W = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin f.length ↦
          U.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W.1 ≤ ⊤)).op
            (h.appTop (AffineSpace.coord S (ULift.up (Fin.natAdd a j)))))) ∧
        RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(U.toScheme, W)
          (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin f.length ↦
            U.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W.1 ≤ ⊤)).op
              (h.appTop (AffineSpace.coord S (ULift.up (Fin.natAdd a j))))))
